d: Hope and dignity move them more; conviction grows fast
Drifts toward whoever seems to be winning
Stress and anger spike; may act without orders
Resists persuasion; conviction hard to shake
News about them and by them travels fast
Shares food readily with those they trust
Sells to the highest bidder; can be bribed
Careless on watch; talks too much
Fought in an earlier war or uprising
Keeps a steady face under pressure
Kindness shown to them is returned
